rules.measured.heading: ## Measured values
rules.measured.intro: The numbers and the yes or no values each check stored, under their names in run.json (checks[ID].measured).
check.EXT-08.name: How fast real users see the page on a phone
check.EXT-08.about: The loading, response and layout stability times of the page on phones, from real Chrome users or, without that data, from Google's lab test.
check.EXT-21.name: Page weight and third-party share
check.EXT-21.about: How much the home page weighs and how much of that weight comes from external services.
check.EXT-20.name: Time to first byte
check.EXT-20.about: How long the server takes to start answering, against a control site measured at the same moment.
check.EXT-18.name: Fast protocols and compression
check.EXT-18.about: Whether the server offers HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 and compresses what it sends.
check.EXT-19.name: Cache or CDN in front of the site
check.EXT-19.about: Whether the answers of the site show a cache or a content delivery network in front of the server.
check.VIS-06.name: Preview when the link is shared
check.VIS-06.about: Whether the page declares the image, title and description that WhatsApp and social networks show when the link is shared.
check.VIS-04.name: Title and description
check.VIS-04.about: Whether the title and the description of the home page say what the site is, at a length search engines show in full.
check.VIS-01.name: Whether Google may show the site
check.VIS-01.about: Whether the home page or robots.txt ask search engines not to show the site.
check.VIS-02.name: Sitemap
check.VIS-02.about: Whether the site publishes a sitemap and robots.txt declares it.
check.VIS-03.name: Canonical address
check.VIS-03.about: Whether each page read declares one canonical address, and that address is its own.
check.VIS-05.name: Main heading
check.VIS-05.about: Whether each page read has exactly one main heading.
check.VIS-07.name: Structured data
check.VIS-07.about: Whether the home page publishes the organisation's data in the structured format search engines read.
check.VIS-08.name: Language versions
check.VIS-08.about: Whether a site with several language versions declares which one belongs to each language.
check.VIS-09.name: Broken links on the home page
check.VIS-09.about: Whether the links of the home page lead to pages that exist, without chains of redirects.
check.VIS-10.name: Contrast and focus
check.VIS-10.about: Whether the text has enough contrast and the focus shows when moving with the keyboard, from Google's automatic test.
check.VIS-11.name: Image descriptions
check.VIS-11.about: Whether the images of the home page carry an alternative text.
check.VIS-12.name: Viewport and zoom
check.VIS-12.about: Whether the page adapts to the width of a phone and lets the reader zoom in.
check.VIS-13.name: Form labels and tap targets
check.VIS-13.about: Whether form fields carry a label and buttons are large enough to tap.
check.VIS-14.name: Page language
check.VIS-14.about: Whether the page declares the language it is written in.
check.VIS-15.name: One-tap contact
check.VIS-15.about: Whether the home page has a link to call or to write on WhatsApp with one tap.
check.EXT-07.name: TLS validity and expiry
check.EXT-07.about: Whether the secure connection of the site is valid and how many days are left before it expires.
check.EXT-13.name: Domain expiry
check.EXT-13.about: When the registration of the domain expires, from the public registry.
check.EXT-17.name: One https address
check.EXT-17.about: Whether the variants of the address, with and without www and https, lead to one secure address.
check.EXT-16.name: Mixed content
check.EXT-16.about: Whether a secure page loads parts of itself over an unencrypted connection.
check.EXT-01.name: Browser protection headers
check.EXT-01.about: How many of the six browser protection headers the site sends.
check.EXT-05.name: Mail authentication
check.EXT-05.about: Whether the domain publishes SPF, DKIM and DMARC, which stop forged mail sent in its name.
check.EXT-23.name: Blocklists
check.EXT-23.about: Whether the domain is on the Spamhaus blocklist.
check.EXT-02.name: WordPress version
check.EXT-02.about: Whether the page shows its WordPress version, and whether that version still gets fixes.
check.EXT-09.name: Server software versions
check.EXT-09.about: Whether the answers of the server name the software and the version it runs.
check.EXT-24.name: Injected spam pages
check.EXT-24.about: Whether the site publishes spam pages or links that are not its own, a sign that it was tampered with.
check.VIS-16.name: Signs of neglect
check.VIS-16.about: Whether the site shows signs of neglect, such as an old year in the footer or stale news.
check.VIS-17.name: Admissions in view
check.VIS-17.about: Whether the site of a school has its admissions link in view.
check.EXT-25.name: Privacy policy
check.EXT-25.about: Whether a site that asks for data in a form links its privacy policy.
check.VIS-18.name: WhatsApp number format
check.VIS-18.about: Whether the WhatsApp links carry the number in a form WhatsApp can open.
check.VIS-19.name: Template leftovers
check.VIS-19.about: Whether sample texts or pages of the theme or of WordPress are still in view.
check.VIS-20.name: Code for retired browsers
check.VIS-20.about: Whether the home page carries code written for Internet Explorer or Flash.
check.VIS-21.name: Published mail addresses
check.VIS-21.about: Whether the domain of each mail address the site publishes can receive mail.
